title: Dynamic ordering in sequence generation in Transformers: experiments on low-resource Tagging scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.21862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces TagInsert, a Transformer-based model that challenges the common left-to-right (L2R) generation paradigm in Transformers, for sequence labelling tasks where dependencies may not naturally align with a L2R order. TagInsert lifts the L2R constraint by removing the decoder-side attention mask and enabling the model to decide a preferred order of tag generation at inference time. We experiment on the common Part-of-Speech tagging and the more complex Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) supertagging tasks on multiple languages and low-resource data settings. We show that, although encoder-only models like BERT remain strong performers for tagging tasks, TagInsert frequently outperforms a L2R encoder-decoder model, achieves results comparable to encoder-only models under data-scarce conditions, and shows better results on the long-tail of rare categories. translated_title: Transformer序列生成中的动态排序：低资源标注场景的实验
translated_abstract: 本文提出了TagInsert，一个基于Transformer的模型，它挑战了Transformer中常见的从左到右（L2R）生成范式，适用于依赖关系可能并不天然符合从左到右顺序的序列标注任务。TagInsert通过移除解码器端的注意力掩码解除了L2R约束，使模型能够在推理时自行决定标签生成的优先顺序。我们在多种语言和低资源数据设置下，对常见的词性标注任务以及更复杂的组合范畴语法（CCG）超标注任务进行了实验。结果表明，尽管BERT等仅编码器模型在标注任务中依然表现强劲，但TagInsert经常优于L2R编码器-解码器模型，在数据稀缺条件下取得了与仅编码器模型相当的结果，并在稀有类别的长尾分布上表现更好。我们的分析显示，TagInsert缓解了典型的误差传播问题。
tldr: 本文提出TagInsert模型，通过移除解码器注意力掩码让Transformer在标注任务中动态决定标签生成顺序，在低资源场景下性能优于从左到右的生成模型，并可媲美仅编码器模型。
en_tdlr: TagInsert removes the decoder-side attention mask to let Transformers dynamically decide the order of tag generation, outperforming left-to-right encoder-decoder models and matching encoder-only models in low-resource tagging scenarios.
